passages.text: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth day of the month—in the fourteenth year after Jerusalem had been struck down—on that very day the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He took me there.
passages.sermon:
Ezekiel was a prophet among the exiles in Babylon.
He spoke about the people of Israel who were taken from their land.
This event happened in the twenty-fifth year of our exile.
It was at the beginning of the year.
It was on the tenth day of the month.
It was fourteen years after Jerusalem had been struck down.
On that very day, the hand of the LORD was upon me.
The LORD took me there.
passages.original: בְּעֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְחָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנָ֣ה לְ֠גָלוּתֵנוּ בְּרֹ֨אשׁ הַשָּׁנָ֜ה בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ בְּאַרְבַּ֤ע עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה אַחַ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֻכְּתָ֖ה הָעִ֑יר בְּעֶ֣צֶם׀ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה הָיְתָ֤ה עָלַי֙ יַד־ יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּבֵ֥א אֹתִ֖י שָֽׁמָּה׃

passages.text: In visions of God He took me to the land of Israel and set me on a very high mountain, on whose southern slope was a structure that resembled a city.
passages.sermon:
God gave me a vision.
God took me to the land of Israel in this vision.
God set me on a very high mountain in Israel.
On the southern slope of this mountain, I saw a structure.
This structure looked like a city.
passages.original: בְּמַרְא֣וֹת אֱלֹהִ֔ים הֱבִיאַ֖נִי אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְנִיחֵ֗נִי אֶל־ הַ֤ר גָּבֹ֙הַּ֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְעָלָ֥יו כְּמִבְנֵה־ עִ֖יר מִנֶּֽגֶב׃

passages.text: So He took me there, and I saw a man whose appearance was like bronze. He was standing in the gateway with a linen cord and a measuring rod in his hand.
passages.sermon:
God took me there.
I saw a man.
The man looked like bronze.
He stood in the gateway.
He held a linen cord in his hand.
He also held a measuring rod in his hand.
passages.original: וַיָּבֵ֨יא אוֹתִ֜י שָׁ֗מָּה וְהִנֵּה־ אִישׁ֙ מַרְאֵ֙הוּ֙ כְּמַרְאֵ֣ה נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וּפְתִיל־ פִּשְׁתִּ֥ים בְּיָד֖וֹ וּקְנֵ֣ה הַמִּדָּ֑ה וְה֥וּא עֹמֵ֖ד בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃

passages.text: “Son of man,” he said to me, “look with your eyes, hear with your ears, and pay attention to everything I am going to show you, for that is why you have been brought here. Report to the house of Israel everything you see.”
passages.sermon:
A man stood before me.
He spoke to me.
He called me "son of man."
He told me to look with my eyes.
He told me to listen with my ears.
He told me to pay attention to everything he would show me.
He said I was brought here so I could see these things.
He commanded me to tell the house of Israel everything I saw.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אֵלַ֜י הָאִ֗ישׁ בֶּן־ אָדָ֡ם רְאֵ֣ה בְעֵינֶיךָ֩ וּבְאָזְנֶ֨יךָ שְּׁמָ֜ע וְשִׂ֣ים לִבְּךָ֗ לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִי֙ מַרְאֶ֣ה אוֹתָ֔ךְ כִּ֛י לְמַ֥עַן הַרְאוֹתְכָ֖ה הֻבָ֣אתָה הֵ֑נָּה הַגֵּ֛ד אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה לְבֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And I saw a wall surrounding the temple area. Now the length of the measuring rod in the man’s hand was six long cubits (each measuring a cubit and a handbreadth), and he measured the wall to be one rod thick and one rod high.
passages.sermon:
I saw a wall.
The wall was outside the temple.
The wall went all the way around the temple.
A man stood there.
The man held a measuring rod in his hand.
The rod was six long cubits.
Each cubit was a cubit and a handbreadth.
The man measured the wall.
The wall was one rod thick.
The wall was one rod high.
passages.original: וְהִנֵּ֥ה חוֹמָ֛ה מִח֥וּץ לַבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב וּבְיַ֨ד הָאִ֜ישׁ קְנֵ֣ה הַמִּדָּ֗ה שֵׁשׁ־ אַמּ֤וֹת בָּֽאַמָּה֙ וָטֹ֔פַח וַיָּ֜מָד אֶת־ רֹ֤חַב הַבִּנְיָן֙ קָנֶ֣ה אֶחָ֔ד וְקוֹמָ֖ה קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Then he came to the gate facing east and climbed its steps. He measured the threshold of the gate to be one rod deep.
passages.sermon:
A man stood before me.
He led me to a gate.
This gate faced east.
He went up the steps of the gate.
He measured the threshold of the gate.
The threshold was one measuring rod deep.
He measured another threshold.
This threshold was also one measuring rod deep.
passages.original: וַיָּב֗וֹא אֶל־ שַׁ֙עַר֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנָיו֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֔ימָה וַיַּ֖עַל בְּמַעֲלוֹתוֹ וַיָּ֣מָד׀ אֶת־ סַ֣ף הַשַּׁ֗עַר קָנֶ֤ה אֶחָד֙ רֹ֔חַב וְאֵת֙ סַ֣ף אֶחָ֔ד קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד רֹֽחַב׃

passages.text: Each gate chamber was one rod long and one rod wide, and there were five cubits between the gate chambers. The inner threshold of the gate by the portico facing inward was one rod deep.
passages.sermon:
Each gate chamber was one rod long.
Each gate chamber was one rod wide.
There were five cubits between the gate chambers.
The inner threshold of the gate by the portico facing inward was one rod deep.
passages.original: וְהַתָּ֗א קָנֶ֨ה אֶחָ֥ד אֹ֙רֶךְ֙ וְקָנֶ֤ה אֶחָד֙ רֹ֔חַב וּבֵ֥ין הַתָּאִ֖ים חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת וְסַ֣ף הַ֠שַּׁעַר מֵאֵ֨צֶל אוּלָ֥ם הַשַּׁ֛עַר מֵֽהַבַּ֖יִת קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Then he measured the portico of the gateway inside; it was eight cubits deep, and its jambs were two cubits thick. And the portico of the gateway faced the temple.
passages.sermon:
A man measured the portico of the gateway inside the temple area.
The portico was eight cubits deep.
The jambs of the portico were two cubits thick.
The portico of the gateway faced the temple.
passages.original: וַיָּ֜מָד אֶת־ אֻלָ֥ם הַשַּׁ֛עַר מֵהַבַּ֖יִת קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃ וַיָּ֜מָד אֶת־ אֻלָ֤ם הַשַּׁ֙עַר֙ שְׁמֹנֶ֣ה אַמּ֔וֹת וְאֵילוֹ שְׁתַּ֣יִם אַמּ֑וֹת וְאֻלָ֥ם הַשַּׁ֖עַר מֵהַבָּֽיִת׃

passages.text: There were three gate chambers on each side of the east gate, each with the same measurements, and the gateposts on either side also had the same measurements.
passages.sermon:
The east gate had gate chambers.
There were three gate chambers on one side.
There were three gate chambers on the other side.
Each gate chamber had the same measurements.
The gateposts on both sides also had the same measurements.
passages.original: וְתָאֵ֨י הַשַּׁ֜עַר דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֗ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה מִפֹּה֙ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה מִפֹּ֔ה מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לִשְׁלָשְׁתָּ֑ם וּמִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת לָאֵילִ֖ם מִפֹּ֥ה וּמִפּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And he measured the width of the gateway entrance to be ten cubits, and its length was thirteen cubits.
passages.sermon: A man measured the entrance of the gateway.\r\nThe entrance was ten cubits wide.\r\nThe gateway was thirteen cubits long.
passages.original: וַיָּ֛מָד אֶת־ רֹ֥חַב פֶּֽתַח־ הַשַּׁ֖עַר עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּ֑וֹת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַשַּׁ֔עַר שְׁל֥וֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה אַמּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: In front of each gate chamber was a wall one cubit high, and the gate chambers were six cubits square.
passages.sermon:
Each gate chamber had a wall in front of it.
The wall was one cubit high.
There was a wall one cubit high on each side.
Each gate chamber measured six cubits from one side to the other.
Each gate chamber measured six cubits from front to back.
passages.original: וּגְב֞וּל לִפְנֵ֤י הַתָּאוֹת֙ אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֔ת וְאַמָּה־ אַחַ֥ת גְּב֖וּל מִפֹּ֑ה וְהַתָּ֕א שֵׁשׁ־ אַמּ֣וֹת מִפּ֔וֹ וְשֵׁ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִפּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then he measured the gateway from the roof of one gate chamber to the roof of the opposite one; the distance was twenty-five cubits from doorway to doorway.
passages.sermon:
A man measured the gateway.
He measured from the roof of one gate chamber to the roof of the opposite gate chamber.
The distance was twenty-five cubits.
He measured from doorway to doorway.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣מָד אֶת־ הַשַּׁ֗עַר מִגַּ֤ג הַתָּא֙ לְגַגּ֔וֹ רֹ֕חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְחָמֵ֖שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת פֶּ֖תַח נֶ֥גֶד פָּֽתַח׃

passages.text: Next he measured the gateposts to be sixty cubits high. The gateway extended around to the gatepost of the courtyard.
passages.sermon:
A man measured the gateposts.
The gateposts were sixty cubits high.
The gateway reached around.
The gateway reached to the gatepost of the courtyard.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־ אֵילִ֖ים שִׁשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֑ה וְאֶל־ אֵיל֙ הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר הַשַּׁ֖עַר סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: And the distance from the entrance of the gateway to the far end of its inner portico was fifty cubits.
passages.sermon:
A man measured the temple gateway.
He measured from the entrance of the gateway.
He measured to the far end of the inner portico.
The distance was fifty cubits.
passages.original: וְעַ֗ל פְּנֵי֙ הַשַּׁ֣עַר הַיֹּאתוֹן עַל־ לִפְנֵ֕י אֻלָ֥ם הַשַּׁ֖עַר הַפְּנִימִ֑י חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים אַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: The gate chambers and their side pillars had beveled windows all around the inside of the gateway. The porticos also had windows all around on the inside. Each side pillar was decorated with palm trees.
passages.sermon:
The gate chambers had beveled windows.
These windows were on the inside of the gateway.
The side pillars also had beveled windows.
The porticos had windows all around on the inside.
Each side pillar was decorated with palm trees.
passages.original: וְחַלֹּנ֣וֹת אֲטֻמ֣וֹת אֶֽל־ הַתָּאִ֡ים וְאֶל֩ אֵלֵיהֵ֨מָה לִפְנִ֤ימָה לַשַּׁ֙עַר֙ סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֔יב וְכֵ֖ן לָאֵֽלַמּ֑וֹת וְחַלּוֹנ֞וֹת סָבִ֤יב׀ סָבִיב֙ לִפְנִ֔ימָה וְאֶל־ אַ֖יִל תִּמֹרִֽים׃

passages.text: Then he brought me into the outer court, and there were chambers and a pavement laid out all around the court. Thirty chambers faced the pavement, which flanked the gateways and corresponded to the length of the gates; this was the lower pavement.
passages.sermon:
He brought me into the outer court.
I saw chambers there.
I saw a pavement laid out all around the court.
There were thirty chambers facing the pavement.
The pavement ran along the sides of the gateways.
The pavement matched the length of the gateways.
This pavement was the lower pavement.
passages.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֗נִי אֶל־ הֶֽחָצֵר֙ הַחִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֤ה לְשָׁכוֹת֙ וְרִֽצְפָ֔ה עָשׂ֥וּי לֶחָצֵ֖ר סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים לְשָׁכ֖וֹת אֶל־ הָרִֽצְפָֽה׃ וְהָרִֽצְפָה֙ אֶל־ כֶּ֣תֶף הַשְּׁעָרִ֔ים לְעֻמַּ֖ת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַשְּׁעָרִ֑ים הָרִֽצְפָ֖ה הַתַּחְתּוֹנָֽה׃

passages.text: Then he measured the distance from the front of the lower gateway to the outside of the inner court; it was a hundred cubits on the east side as well as on the north.
passages.sermon:
A man measured the distance at the temple.
He measured from the front of the lower gateway.
He measured to the outside of the inner court.
The distance was one hundred cubits.
This measurement was on the east side.
This measurement was also on the north side.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣מָד רֹ֡חַב מִלִּפְנֵי֩ הַשַּׁ֨עַר הַתַּחְתּ֜וֹנָה לִפְנֵ֨י הֶחָצֵ֧ר הַפְּנִימִ֛י מִח֖וּץ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֑ה הַקָּדִ֖ים וְהַצָּפֽוֹן׃

passages.text: He also measured the length and width of the gateway of the outer court facing north.
passages.sermon:
A man led me to the outer court.
The outer court had a gateway.
This gateway faced north.
He measured the gateway.
He measured its length.
He measured its width.
passages.original: וְהַשַּׁ֗עַר אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנָיו֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן לֶחָצֵ֖ר הַחִֽיצוֹנָ֑ה מָדַ֥ד אָרְכּ֖וֹ וְרָחְבּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Its three gate chambers on each side, its side pillars, and its portico all had the same measurements as the first gate: fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
passages.sermon:
The gateway had three gate chambers on each side.
It had side pillars.
It had a portico.
All these parts had the same measurements as the first gate.
The gateway was fifty cubits long.
The gateway was twenty-five cubits wide.
passages.original: וְתָאוֹ שְׁלוֹשָׁ֤ה מִפּוֹ֙ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה מִפּ֔וֹ וְאֵילוֹ וְאֵלַמּוֹ הָיָ֔ה כְּמִדַּ֖ת הַשַּׁ֣עַר הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔וֹ וְרֹ֕חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים בָּאַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: Its windows, portico, and palm trees had the same measurements as those of the gate facing east. Seven steps led up to it, with its portico opposite them.
passages.sermon:
This passage describes the gateway of the outer court of the temple.
The gateway faces north.
Its windows had the same measurements as the windows of the gate facing east.
Its portico had the same measurements as the portico of the gate facing east.
Its palm tree decorations had the same measurements as those of the gate facing east.
Seven steps led up to the gateway.
The portico stood opposite the steps.
passages.original: וְחַלּוֹנוֹ וְאֵלַמּוֹ וְתִמֹרוֹ כְּמִדַּ֣ת הַשַּׁ֔עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֑ים וּבְמַעֲל֥וֹת שֶׁ֙בַע֙ יַֽעֲלוּ־ ב֔וֹ וְאֵילַמּוֹ לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: There was a gate to the inner court facing the north gate, just as there was on the east. He measured the distance from gateway to gateway to be a hundred cubits.
passages.sermon:
A gate led to the inner court.
This gate faced the north gate.
There was also a gate on the east side.
He measured the distance from one gate to the other.
The distance was one hundred cubits.
passages.original: וְשַׁ֙עַר֙ לֶחָצֵ֣ר הַפְּנִימִ֔י נֶ֣גֶד הַשַּׁ֔עַר לַצָּפ֖וֹן וְלַקָּדִ֑ים וַיָּ֧מָד מִשַּׁ֛עַר אֶל־ שַׁ֖עַר מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: Then he led me to the south side, and I saw a gateway facing south. He measured its side pillars and portico, and they had the same measurements as the others.
passages.sermon:
A man led me to the south side.
I saw a gateway that faced south.
He measured the side pillars of the gateway.
He measured the portico of the gateway.
The side pillars and the portico had the same measurements as the other gateways.
passages.original: וַיּוֹלִכֵ֙נִי֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֔וֹם וְהִנֵּה־ שַׁ֖עַר דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֑וֹם וּמָדַ֤ד אֵילוֹ וְאֵילַמּוֹ כַּמִּדּ֖וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: Both the gateway and its portico had windows all around, like the other windows. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
passages.sermon:
The gateway had windows all around it.
Its portico also had windows all around it.
These windows were like the other windows.
The gateway was fifty cubits long.
The gateway was twenty-five cubits wide.
passages.original: וְחַלּוֹנִ֨ים ל֤וֹ וּלְאֵילַמּוֹ סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֔יב כְּהַחֲלֹּנ֖וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְרֹ֕חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: Seven steps led up to it, and its portico was opposite them; it had palm trees on its side pillars, one on each side.
passages.sermon:
The gateway faced south.
Seven steps led up to the gateway.
The portico stood in front of the steps.
Each side pillar had a palm tree carved on it.
There was one palm tree on each side pillar.
passages.original: וּמַעֲל֤וֹת שִׁבְעָה֙ עֹלוֹתוֹ וְאֵלַמּוֹ לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם וְתִמֹרִ֣ים ל֗וֹ אֶחָ֥ד מִפּ֛וֹ וְאֶחָ֥ד מִפּ֖וֹ אֶל־ אֵילוֹ׃

passages.text: The inner court also had a gate facing south, and he measured the distance from gateway to gateway toward the south to be a hundred cubits.
passages.sermon:
The inner court had a gate.
This gate faced south.
He measured the distance from one gateway to the other gateway toward the south.
The distance was one hundred cubits.
passages.original: וְשַׁ֛עַר לֶחָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִ֖י דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֑וֹם וַיָּ֨מָד מִשַּׁ֧עַר אֶל־ הַשַּׁ֛עַר דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַדָּר֖וֹם מֵאָ֥ה אַמּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Next he brought me into the inner court through the south gate, and he measured the south gate; it had the same measurements as the others.
passages.sermon:
A man led me into the inner court.
We entered through the south gate.
He measured the south gate.
The south gate had the same measurements as the other gates.
passages.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֛נִי אֶל־ חָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִ֖י בְּשַׁ֣עַר הַדָּר֑וֹם וַיָּ֙מָד֙ אֶת־ הַשַּׁ֣עַר הַדָּר֔וֹם כַּמִּדּ֖וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: Its gate chambers, side pillars, and portico had the same measurements as the others. Both the gateway and its portico had windows all around; it was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
passages.sermon:
The inner court had a gate on the south side.
This gate had gate chambers.
It had side pillars.
It had a portico.
These parts had the same measurements as the other gates.
The gateway had windows all around it.
The portico also had windows all around it.
The gateway was fifty cubits long.
It was twenty-five cubits wide.
passages.original: וְתָאוֹ וְאֵילוֹ וְאֵלַמּוֹ כַּמִּדּ֣וֹת הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְחַלּוֹנ֥וֹת ל֛וֹ וּלְאֵלַמּוֹ סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְרֹ֕חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְחָמֵ֖שׁ אַמּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: (The porticoes around the inner court were twenty-five cubits long and five cubits deep.)
passages.sermon: The porticoes stood around the inner court.\r\nEach portico was twenty-five cubits long.\r\nEach portico was five cubits deep.
passages.original: וְאֵֽלַמּ֖וֹת סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב אֹ֗רֶךְ חָמֵ֤שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֖חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Its portico faced the outer court, and its side pillars were decorated with palm trees. Eight steps led up to it.
passages.sermon:
This passage describes a part of the temple’s gate structure.
The portico faced the outer court.
The side pillars had palm tree decorations.
Eight steps led up to the portico.
passages.original: וְאֵלַמָּ֗ו אֶל־ חָצֵר֙ הַחִ֣צוֹנָ֔ה וְתִמֹרִ֖ים אֶל־ אֵילוֹ וּמַעֲל֥וֹת שְׁמוֹנֶ֖ה מַעֲלוֹ

passages.text: And he brought me to the inner court on the east side, and he measured the gateway; it had the same measurements as the others.
passages.sermon:
A man led me to the inner court.
He took me by the way of the east side.
He measured the gateway there.
The gateway had the same measurements as the other gateways.
passages.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֛נִי אֶל־ הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִ֖י דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֑ים וַיָּ֣מָד אֶת־ הַשַּׁ֔עַר כַּמִּדּ֖וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: Its gate chambers, side pillars, and portico had the same measurements as the others. Both the gateway and its portico had windows all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
passages.sermon:
The gateway had gate chambers, side pillars, and a portico.
These parts had the same measurements as the other gateways.
The gateway had windows all around.
The portico also had windows all around.
The gateway was fifty cubits long.
The gateway was twenty-five cubits wide.
passages.original: וְתָאוֹ וְאֵלוֹ וְאֵלַמּוֹ כַּמִּדּ֣וֹת הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְחַלּוֹנ֥וֹת ל֛וֹ וּלְאֵלַמּוֹ סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב אֹ֚רֶךְ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֕חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: Its portico faced the outer court, and its side pillars were decorated with palm trees on each side. Eight steps led up to it.
passages.sermon: The portico faced the outer court.\r\nPalm trees decorated the side pillars on each side.\r\nEight steps led up to the portico.
passages.original: וְאֵלַמּוֹ לֶֽחָצֵר֙ הַחִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה וְתִמֹרִ֥ים אֶל־ אֵלוֹ מִפּ֣וֹ וּמִפּ֑וֹ וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מַעֲל֖וֹת מַעֲלוֹ׃

passages.text: Then he brought me to the north gate and measured it. It had the same measurements as the others, as did its gate chambers, side pillars, and portico. It also had windows all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
passages.sermon:
A man led me to the north gate.
He measured the north gate.
The north gate had the same measurements as the other gates.
Its gate chambers had the same measurements as the others.
Its side pillars had the same measurements as the others.
Its portico had the same measurements as the others.
The north gate had windows all around it.
The north gate was fifty cubits long.
The north gate was twenty-five cubits wide.
passages.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֖נִי אֶל־ שַׁ֣עַר הַצָּפ֑וֹן וּמָדַ֖ד כַּמִּדּ֥וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ תָּאוֹ אֵלוֹ וְאֵלַמּוֹ וְחַלּוֹנ֥וֹת ל֖וֹ סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב אֹ֚רֶךְ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֕חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: Its portico faced the outer court, and its side pillars were decorated with palm trees on each side. Eight steps led up to it.
passages.sermon:
This passage describes a gateway in the temple vision of Ezekiel.
The portico of the gateway faced the outer court.
The side pillars of the portico had palm tree decorations on each side.
Eight steps led up to the portico.
passages.original: וְאֵילוֹ לֶֽחָצֵר֙ הַחִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה וְתִמֹרִ֥ים אֶל־ אֵילוֹ מִפּ֣וֹ וּמִפּ֑וֹ וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מַעֲל֖וֹת מַעֲלוֹ׃

passages.text: There was a chamber with a doorway by the portico in each of the inner gateways. There the burnt offering was to be washed.
passages.sermon:
The temple had inner gateways.
Each inner gateway had a portico.
Beside each portico, there was a chamber.
Each chamber had a doorway.
Priests washed the burnt offering in these chambers.
passages.original: וְלִשְׁכָּ֣ה וּפִתְחָ֔הּ בְּאֵילִ֖ים הַשְּׁעָרִ֑ים שָׁ֖ם יָדִ֥יחוּ אֶת־ הָעֹלָֽה׃

passages.text: Inside the portico of the gateway were two tables on each side, on which the burnt offerings, sin offerings, and guilt offerings were to be slaughtered.
passages.sermon:
The gateway had a portico.
Inside this portico, there were tables.
There were two tables on one side.
There were two tables on the other side.
Priests used these tables to slaughter offerings.
They slaughtered burnt offerings on these tables.
They slaughtered sin offerings on these tables.
They slaughtered guilt offerings on these tables.
passages.original: וּבְאֻלָ֣ם הַשַּׁ֗עַר שְׁנַ֤יִם שֻׁלְחָנוֹת֙ מִפּ֔וֹ וּשְׁנַ֥יִם שֻׁלְחָנ֖וֹת מִפֹּ֑ה לִשְׁח֤וֹט אֲלֵיהֶם֙ הָעוֹלָ֔ה וְהַחַטָּ֖את וְהָאָשָֽׁם׃

passages.text: Outside, as one goes up to the entrance of the north gateway, there were two tables on one side and two more tables on the other side of the gate’s portico.
passages.sermon:
The temple had gateways with porticos.
The north gateway had an entrance.
Outside this entrance, there were tables.
As a person approached the north gateway, they saw two tables on one side.
There were also two tables on the other side of the portico.
In total, there were four tables outside the entrance of the north gateway.
passages.original: וְאֶל־ הַכָּתֵ֣ף מִח֗וּצָה לָעוֹלֶה֙ לְפֶ֙תַח֙ הַשַּׁ֣עַר הַצָּפ֔וֹנָה שְׁנַ֖יִם שֻׁלְחָנ֑וֹת וְאֶל־ הַכָּתֵ֣ף הָאַחֶ֗רֶת אֲשֶׁר֙ לְאֻלָ֣ם הַשַּׁ֔עַר שְׁנַ֖יִם שֻׁלְחָנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: So there were four tables inside the gateway and four outside—eight tables in all—on which the sacrifices were to be slaughtered.
passages.sermon:
There were four tables inside the gateway.
There were four tables outside the gateway.
There were eight tables in total.
People used these tables to slaughter the sacrifices.
passages.original: אַרְבָּעָ֨ה שֻׁלְחָנ֜וֹת מִפֹּ֗ה וְאַרְבָּעָ֧ה שֻׁלְחָנ֛וֹת מִפֹּ֖ה לְכֶ֣תֶף הַשָּׁ֑עַר שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה שֻׁלְחָנ֖וֹת אֲלֵיהֶ֥ם יִשְׁחָֽטוּ׃

passages.text: There were also four tables of dressed stone for the burnt offering, each a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit high. On these were placed the utensils used to slaughter the burnt offerings and the other sacrifices.
passages.sermon:
There were four tables for the burnt offering.
The tables were made of dressed stone.
Each table was one and a half cubits long.
Each table was one and a half cubits wide.
Each table was one cubit high.
People placed the utensils on these tables.
The utensils were used to slaughter the burnt offerings and other sacrifices.
passages.original: וְאַרְבָּעָה֩ שֻׁלְחָנ֨וֹת לָעוֹלָ֜ה אַבְנֵ֣י גָזִ֗ית אֹרֶךְ֩ אַמָּ֨ה אַחַ֤ת וָחֵ֙צִי֙ וְרֹ֨חַב אַמָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ וָחֵ֔צִי וְגֹ֖בַהּ אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם וְיַנִּ֤יחוּ אֶת־ הַכֵּלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁחֲט֧וּ אֶת־ הָעוֹלָ֛ה בָּ֖ם וְהַזָּֽבַח׃

passages.text: The double-pronged hooks, each a handbreadth long, were fastened all around the inside of the room, and the flesh of the offering was to be placed on the tables.
passages.sermon:
Double-pronged hooks were in the room.
Each hook was a handbreadth long.
People fastened these hooks all around the inside of the room.
They placed the flesh of the offering on the tables.
passages.original: וְהַֽשְׁפַתַּ֗יִם טֹ֧פַח אֶחָ֛ד מוּכָנִ֥ים בַּבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב וְאֶל־ הַשֻּׁלְחָנ֖וֹת בְּשַׂ֥ר הַקָּרְבָֽן׃

passages.text: Outside the inner gate, within the inner court, were two chambers, one beside the north gate and facing south, and another beside the south gate and facing north.
passages.sermon:
The temple had an inner court.
Inside this inner court stood two chambers.
Both chambers were outside the inner gate.
One chamber was beside the north gate.
This chamber faced south.
The other chamber was beside the south gate.
This chamber faced north.
passages.original: וּמִחוּצָה֩ לַשַּׁ֨עַר הַפְּנִימִ֜י לִֽשְׁכ֣וֹת שָׁרִ֗ים בֶּחָצֵ֤ר הַפְּנִימִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֗ר אֶל־ כֶּ֙תֶף֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַצָּפ֔וֹן וּפְנֵיהֶ֖ם דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֑וֹם אֶחָ֗ד אֶל־ כֶּ֙תֶף֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַקָּדִ֔ים פְּנֵ֖י דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַצָּפֹֽן׃

passages.text: Then the man said to me: “The chamber that faces south is for the priests who keep charge of the temple, and the chamber that faces north is for the priests who keep charge of the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, the only Levites who may approach the LORD to minister before Him.”
passages.sermon:
A man spoke to me.
He explained the purpose of the chambers.
The chamber that faces south is for the priests.
These priests keep charge of the temple.
The chamber that faces north is for other priests.
These priests keep charge of the altar.
These priests are the sons of Zadok.
The sons of Zadok are Levites.
Only the sons of Zadok may approach the LORD.
They alone may minister before Him.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלָ֑י זֹ֣ה הַלִּשְׁכָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנֶ֙יהָ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֔וֹם לַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַבָּֽיִת׃ וְהַלִּשְׁכָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנֶ֙יהָ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן לַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ הֵ֣מָּה בְנֵֽי־ צָד֗וֹק הַקְּרֵבִ֧ים מִבְּנֵֽי־ לֵוִ֛י אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה לְשָׁרְתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Next he measured the court. It was square, a hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits wide. And the altar was in front of the temple.
passages.sermon:
The man measured the court.
The court was square.
The court was one hundred cubits long.
The court was one hundred cubits wide.
The altar stood in front of the temple.
passages.original: וַיָּ֨מָד אֶת־ הֶחָצֵ֜ר אֹ֣רֶךְ׀ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֗ה וְרֹ֛חַב מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּ֖ה מְרֻבָּ֑עַת וְהַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לִפְנֵ֥י הַבָּֽיִת׃

passages.text: Then he brought me to the portico of the temple and measured the side pillars of the portico to be five cubits on each side. The width of the gateway was fourteen cubits and its sidewalls were three cubits on either side.
passages.sermon:
A man led me to the portico of the temple.
He measured the side pillars of the portico.
Each side pillar was five cubits wide.
The gateway was fourteen cubits wide.
Each sidewall of the gateway was three cubits wide.
passages.original: וַיְבִאֵנִי֮ אֶל־ אֻלָ֣ם הַבַּיִת֒ וַיָּ֙מָד֙ אֵ֣ל אֻלָ֔ם חָמֵ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ מִפֹּ֔ה וְחָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִפֹּ֑ה וְרֹ֣חַב הַשַּׁ֔עַר שָׁלֹ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ מִפּ֔וֹ וְשָׁלֹ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִפּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The portico was twenty cubits wide and twelve cubits deep, and ten steps led up to it. There were columns by the side pillars, one on each side.
passages.sermon:
The portico stood at the front of the temple.
The portico was twenty cubits wide.
The portico was twelve cubits deep.
Ten steps led up to the portico.
There were columns by the side pillars.
One column stood on each side.
passages.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ הָאֻלָ֞ם עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּ֗ה וְרֹ֙חַב֙ עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אַמָּ֔ה וּבַֽמַּעֲל֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲל֖וּ אֵלָ֑יו וְעַמֻּדִים֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אֵילִ֔ים אֶחָ֥ד מִפֹּ֖ה וְאֶחָ֥ד מִפֹּֽה׃
